title: Lead Console slim index
description: One element per church, sorted by id. ~890 B/church raw, ~2.2 MB gzipped for all 14,396. TWO INVARIANTS: (1) every field here is rendered on a list row or read by a filter, facet, sort or the favor engine -- nothing else; (2) the index carries NO quotes and NO source URLs, so it must never assert an answer to a human beyond a colour and a label. The moment the UI wants to show why, it fetches the full record.

id.title: org_id
id.description: The stable church key. THE join key for every mark, note and export. Survives a data republish.

ts.title: fetched_last
ts.description: Last scrape date. Renders as 'scraped <date>' and drives the 'recently scraped' sort.

l.description: false means no page was read. The tile must then say 'not checked', NEVER '0 of 8'.

s.description: 8 characters in STEP_CATS order (connect, baptism, group, classes, membership, serve, giving, other): p = present, a = absent_looked, n = not_looked.

lo.title: logo sha256
lo.description: Content-addressed key into logos-thumb/ (and logos/ when the full-size originals are shipped -- a --slim build omits that folder). Absent when the church has no logo: `lo` is set ONLY when the brand record ships one, so a missing `lo` is the pipeline's answer, not a gap in the fixture.

lt.title: brand.logo_theme
lt.description: light | dark | either | unknown. 'dark' means a near-white cut-out that needs the #2b2b30 backing to be visible at all.

lr.title: logo_reject / logo_absent_reason
lr.description: Why there is no logo. 'No logo found' and 'we rejected the one we found' are different facts and the tile says which.

em.title: contact.preview
em.description: Up to 3 contacts: {e: email, r: role label, l: person or office name}.

so.title: contact.social
so.description: ONLY present when em is empty. Rendered as links with NO Copy button.

rec.title: record sha256
rec.description: The lazy-fetch key for the full record.
